cafe-de-la-corte.title: Craft translated into a packaging system
cafe-de-la-corte.text: Café De La Corte is positioned around craftsmanship, richness and refined taste. The design task was to carry an established identity into a physical system that felt premium at first glance and remained believable at close range. Every decision—from the glass treatment to the label hierarchy and sleeve construction—was shaped by how the product would be held, poured, displayed and produced.

cafe-de-la-corte.alt: Café De La Corte bottle with the original transparent shield label and hand-tied burlap sleeve
cafe-de-la-corte.caption: The original bottle, label and textile sleeve shown as one coherent packaging object.

cafe-de-la-corte.title: Luxury with raw materiality
cafe-de-la-corte.text: The packaging pairs warm glass tones and restrained metallic details with coarse burlap and hand-tied twine. That contrast gives the product a distinctive tension: polished enough for a premium shelf, yet tactile enough to signal craft and authenticity. The material palette also keeps the identity recognisable when the bottle is viewed from different distances and angles.

cafe-de-la-corte.title: A system designed around the bottle
cafe-de-la-corte.text: The bottle’s proportions informed the scale and placement of every element. The transparent label preserves the visual richness of the coffee, while the burlap sleeve introduces warmth, grip and shelf presence. Repeating the shield mark across glass and textile keeps the touchpoints connected without making the package feel over-branded.

cafe-de-la-corte.title: A tactile premium experience
cafe-de-la-corte.text: The result is a packaging language built on contrast: clarity and texture, refinement and craft, glass and fibre. Rather than adding decorative complexity, the system gives each material a clear role—making the product feel richer while keeping the brand legible and coherent.

cafe-de-la-corte.caption: A coherent system of glass, fibre and cord.
The packaging in a warm hospitality setting.

noghteh.title: A quiet identity with physical presence
noghteh.text: Noghteh is presented through material, proportion and space. The mark stays deliberately restrained while paper, embossing, shadow and architectural scale carry the visual rhythm.

noghteh.caption: Material language · oak, concrete and glass.
A quiet signature on tactile paper.

noghteh.title: From object to environment
noghteh.text: The same restrained palette expands into a spatial identity. Large fields of charcoal frame the work, translucent banners create a lighter middle layer and small identity moments guide attention through the space.

noghteh.caption: A modular exhibition space where the identity supports the architecture.

noghteh.title: Minimal, measured, repeatable
noghteh.text: The presentation avoids showing every possible application. A limited set of carefully framed moments demonstrates how the identity behaves across print and space while preserving clarity and restraint.
